## V. FIGURE CAPTIONS:

## Figure 1:

The atom numbering for PIC is shown as it is used to tabulate the parameters

## Figure 2:

The experimental absorption spectrum 4 of monomeric PIC (dots) is compared with a calculated spectrum (full line) from the displaced oscillator model. The calculated spectrum was shifted to reproduce the absorption maximum at 19100 cm -1

## Figure 3:

Starting from a sandwich (a) or brickwork (b) structure relative stable dimer configurations evolved. The figure shows representative snapshots.
